WFRPPD.Title: Equipment
WFRPPD.Hint: Drag an item onto a bag section to move it there. Bags go into the three slots on top. Double-click to equip/unequip, right-click to open.

Tooltip.Hint: Double-click to equip/unequip · Right-click to open
Tooltip.HasTable: Description has a table - right-click to open
Tooltip.UnderLayer: Can be worn under other armour

Money.Title: Money
Money.ClickHint: LMB - add, RMB - remove, Shift - by 10. Change is made automatically.
Money.Rates: 1 Gold Crown = 20 Silver Shillings = 240 Brass Pennies. 1 Shilling = 12 Pennies.

Warn.NotOwned: Add the item to the character first, then equip it from the paperdoll.

Fly.BisHint: Best item you own for this slot

Stats.Modified: Modified: {mod} (effects, talents or a sheet edit)
Stats.PartsHint:
Breakdown
I - Initial
A - Advances
M - Modifier (effects, talents, sheet edits)

Restr.UntrainedHint: No {skill} specialisation: the weapon loses its qualities, flaws stay
Restr.OffHandHint: Attacking with the off hand is penalised. Ambidextrous reduces it
Restr.CultUlric: Ulric: blackpowder, helmets, crossbows and technology are not the way of Ulric
Restr.ForbiddenHint: Not allowed by the rules - excluded from BIS
Restr.OffHandParryHint: Off-hand attacks are penalised. Melee (Parry) removes the penalty when defending. Ambidextrous reduces the attack penalty
Restr.NoAmmoHint: No matching arrows, bolts or shot in the inventory - nothing to shoot
Restr.LayerHint: Only Flexible armour or soft leather can be worn under other armour (p. 300). Two rigid layers on one location are up to the GM
Restr.SkillPenaltyHint: Each piece of mail or plate gives -10 Stealth. Helmets and coifs hinder Perception (p. 300)

Effects.HintCondition: LMB - remove 1 level · Shift+LMB - remove all · RMB - details
Effects.DeleteConfirm: Remove «{name}» from the character? This cannot be undone.
Effects.HintItemEffect: LMB or RMB - open the source

Talent.DualWielder: Dual Wielder: attacks with both hands
Talent.NoText: No description on the sheet or in the compendiums
Talent.Hint: Book icon on the right - rules article

Bags.Full: "{bag}" can't fit it: {used} of {cap} used, item weighs {weight}.
Bags.NoFreeSlot: All three bag slots are taken. Remove one or swap via the arrow.
Bags.Overflow: More than three bags worn, not in slots: {names}
Bags.PackHint: Equips the roomiest spare bags first, then packs the heaviest carried items into them. Two-handed and polearm weapons stay out
Bags.NoBags: No bags at all. Get a bag to pack your things
Bags.PackNothing: Nothing to pack: heavy items are already in bags or don't fit
Bags.NoNesting: «{item}» is a bag and cannot go inside another bag.

ItemIcons.Name: Module item icons
ItemIcons.Hint: Replace wfrp4e-core placeholder icons (sack, sword, bow) with the module's drawn icons.

Enabled.Name: Module enabled
Enabled.Hint: Turn off to keep the module installed but inactive: no sheet button, no hotkey, no token double-click override. World setting: affects the whole table.

EncHint.Load: Load {current} of {max}. Encumbered above {max}, heavily above {x2}, above {x3} the character cannot move.
EncHint.Max: Over three times the limit: the character cannot move.
EncHint.Fatigue: after a day of travel - Fatigued
EncHint.Fatigue2: after a day of travel - Fatigued (2)
EncHint.Extra: gains 1 extra Fatigued when tired for any other reason

prices.Name: Show item prices
prices.Hint: Approximate value in tooltips. The GM always sees prices.

sounds.Name: Interface sounds
sounds.Hint: Coin clink when money is gained or spent.

detailedStats.Name: Detailed characteristics
detailedStats.Hint: Show characteristics as «I 35 + A 10 + M 0 = 45»: initial, advances, modifier

tokenDblClick.Name: Token double-click opens the equipment
tokenDblClick.Hint: Opens the equipment window instead of the character sheet. Alt + double-click opens the usual sheet

hotkey.Name: Equipment hotkey
hotkey.Hint: Open and close the equipment window with a key (I by default). Change the key in Configure Controls → module

passiveBuffs.Name: Show passive buffs
passiveBuffs.Hint: Permanent effects of talents, traits and items in the effects strip. Temporary buffs (blessings, Frenzy) always show

translateTerms.Name: Translate game terms
translateTerms.Hint: Show characteristic, skill, talent and condition names in Russian per the rulebook (Russian client, English data).

translateText.Name: Translate descriptions
translateText.Hint: Machine-translate English texts in tooltips. Chrome uses the built-in browser translator (local, not always available). Google is an unofficial free endpoint: texts are sent to Google and it may stop working. Results are cached.

translateDescOnly.Name: Translate only descriptions and flavour text
translateDescOnly.Hint: Names, terms and rules stay as they are; only item, effect and talent descriptions are translated.

effectDurations.Name: Effect durations
effectDurations.Hint: '3r' / '2h' badge on the effect icon and 'Left' line in the tooltip.

unarmed.Name: Fists with empty hands
unarmed.Hint: An empty weapon slot shows 'Unarmed'; main-hand damage uses fists (SB+0).

restButton.Name: Rest on the wounds bar
restButton.Hint: ⟲ button on the wounds bar: Endurance +20, heals TB + SL.

rolls.Name: Rolls from the window
rolls.Hint: Dice on the weapon slot - attack; click a characteristic or skill name - test.

shiftCompare.Name: Shift to compare
shiftCompare.Hint: Hold Shift over a weapon or armour in the bag to see what's equipped in that slot.

Vitals.WoundsHint: Wounds {value} of {max}. At 0 any new wound is a Critical
Vitals.FortuneHint: Fortune {value} of {max}: spend 1 to reroll a test or add +1 SL. Refills to Fate each session

SecondHint.fortune: Fortune {value} of {max}: spend 1 to reroll a test or add +1 SL. Refills up to Fate each session
SecondHint.resolve: Resolve {value} of {max}: spend 1 to ignore psychology or conditions (except Unconscious) until the end of next round. Refills up to Resilience when acting on your Motivation
SecondHint.corruption: Corruption {value} of {max}: exceeding the limit triggers a mutation test
SecondHint.advantage: Advantage {value} of {max}: +10 to combat tests each

Hotkey.Name: Open / close equipment
Hotkey.Hint: Equipment window of the selected token (or your character). Works when enabled in the module settings
Hotkey.NoActor: Select your token or assign a character to your user

Uses.s: thrown weapons and some bows: Strength-based damage
Uses.t: subtracted from the damage of every hit (with armour)
Uses.wp: range and duration of many spells and prayers
Uses.fel: how many people you can sway or lead (Charm, Leadership)

Unarmed.Name: Unarmed - fists
Unarmed.Note: An empty hand punches; this 'weapon' can't be removed

Rest.Title: Rest and recover
Rest.Night: Night of sleep: Endurance +20, heals TB + SL

Roll.Click: Click the name to roll a test

SettingsMenu.Title: Character equipment: settings
SettingsMenu.Hint: All module settings by category: display, rules, controls, translation, party.

Intro.display: What the window shows. Each player has their own settings.
Intro.rules: Which WFRP rules the module handles for you.
Intro.controls: Hotkeys, clicks and drag & drop. The window key is changed in Foundry's Configure Controls.
Intro.general: Master switch for the module. The other tabs configure how it behaves.
